fact_text: Pakistan's fiscal year FY26 began on 1 July 2025 with a budget presented in June 2025; the budget passed with minor changes and implementation started on 1 July.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: A levy of 1% or 2% on new vehicles, set by engine capacity, was introduced as part of a climate-linked surcharge tied to funding Pakistan borrowed from the IMF.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest objected that the engine-capacity levy is charged on a price that already includes duties and taxes, which he called double taxation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The budget introduced a climate levy of Rs 50 per litre on petrol and diesel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The petrol and diesel climate levy is scheduled to fall to Rs 5 per litre from 1 July 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Pensions, which were previously untaxed, are taxed under the new rule, with annual pensions above PKR 10 million taxed at 5%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Recipients aged 70 and above remain exempt from the new tax on high annual pensions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said public-sector pensions had been the one group with untaxed retirement income, and that taxing large pensions is right.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest argued that every income should be taxed at some rate, and exemptions should be limited to low-income groups such as salaried workers, not to large pension incomes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker suggested cutting tax rates first to bring the sector into the net, and raising them gradually once documentation is in place.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest said Pakistan's tax problem is the narrow base, so lower rates on a wide base would collect more than high rates on a few payers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker described retail and agriculture as the two big sectors where political will to tax is missing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Earlier schemes for retailers, a fixed-tax concept and then the Tajir Dost scheme, were not successful in the speaker's view, and the Tajir Dost scheme failed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker proposed a 'mirror policy' in which the government shows businesses the data it already holds on them, such as electricity and travel records, so they document their income.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest said the FBR already holds data from electricity bills and travel records, and that a past finance minister's budget speech cited large volumes of data used to issue notices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said the shortfall in tax collection comes mainly from missing political will and political compromise, not from a lack of data.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said the tax revenue target should be about PKR 20 trillion for FY26, and noted the FBR had not reached earlier targets of 14 or 12 trillion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said the IMF pushes tariff rationalisation on luxury cars but does not press for agricultural income tax or retail taxation, because it acts on what the government presents to it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Tariff rationalisation is expected to cut duties on luxury cars gradually over several years, while small-car sales tax was raised.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said donor agencies such as the World Bank focus on recovering their own lending and do not weigh long-term effects of tax measures on ordinary people.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said governments take a short-term view, relying on IMF loans and climate-finance inflows, which he said build long-run liabilities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Climate funding is easy to borrow, but the speaker said it becomes a liability if the reforms it is meant to fund are not implemented.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Sales tax on services and withholding at source were raised: the services-sector withholding rate was raised to 15%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said service-sector margins cannot absorb a higher withholding rate, and called for a national roadmap so businesses can sustain the change.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: Online sales and home-based online businesses were brought into the tax net, with a 2% income tax and a 2% sales tax applied to the sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker argued that online and home-based sellers earn good incomes but pay nothing, so a 2% regime is a small price for documenting the sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said cost increases on everyday purchases widen the trust and documentation gap, because people with less purchasing power look for ways to avoid documentation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said a salaried majority on low pay makes higher taxes on transport and consumer goods regressive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said higher taxes on small cars and motorcycles pass through to end consumers, which hits middle-class buyers and the people who use cars to provide transport services.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest said motorcycle sales were booming in Aug 2025, which he used as a reason the segment could bear higher tax.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: On a Rs 100 invoice the speaker cited Rs 15 of sales tax, and said tax withheld on a tax-inclusive basis compounds the unfairness.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The budget raised the agricultural income tax rate to as high as 40%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker argued agriculture should be taxed on produce or cultivated area rather than on assessed income, because farm income is hard to assess.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker's example: a farmer owning 10 acres and cultivating 5 should pay tax on the cultivated area, not on the land owned.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said landowners dominate provincial assemblies, so provinces are unlikely to tax agriculture; a 26th constitutional amendment could allow federal collection.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said end-to-end digitisation and AI-based systems are the only route to documenting the economy and a fair tax system.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: E-invoicing for FMCG firms was announced in FY25 but, the speaker said, has not been implemented for any company, while the rollout was announced for everyone.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest said sales tax notices and proceedings are not yet visible on the FBR's IRIS portal, although returns can be filed there.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The guest described a new requirement that access to FBR services needs a QR code, as a late step after long delays in implementation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said tax policy belongs to government, not the FBR, which is only an executor; lawmakers lack tax knowledge, so the FBR ends up drafting policy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said measures are being added piecemeal and each IMF programme sets higher targets, so Pakistan needs a national documentation roadmap.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said tax targets keep rising each year, and governments meet them by raising existing taxes rather than broadening the base.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The climate-linked carbon levy introduced in FY26 was described by the speaker as a genuinely new tax, unlike most budget measures that raise existing taxes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker compared Dubai, which has a 5% VAT and where every transaction is visible to the revenue authority, with Pakistan's documentation gap.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker argued that any activity earning money should contribute a government share, and that one sector's non-compliance should not justify another's.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said heavy road traffic, crowded markets and restaurant waits of about an hour show business is active but not captured by tax records.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)

fact_text: The speaker said attendance by parliamentarians at pre-budget tax discussions is low because they lack tax knowledge, leaving the FBR to write policy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Retail and Agriculture: The Black Holes of Pakistan’s Tax System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-13)
